passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.1
passages.text: Gratulor Oechaliam titulis accedere nostris;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.2
passages.text: Victorem victae succubuisse queror.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.3
passages.text: Fama Pelasgiadas subito pervenit in urbes

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.4
passages.text: Decolor et factis infitianda tuis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.5
passages.text: Quem numquam Iuno seriesque inmensa laborum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.6
passages.text: Fregerit, huic Iolen inposuisse iugum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.7
passages.text: Hoc velit Eurystheus, velit hoc germana Tonantis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.8
passages.text: Laetaque sit vitae labe noverca tuae;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.9
passages.text: At non ille, brevis cui nox — si creditur — una

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.10
passages.text: Luctanti, ut tantus conciperere, fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.11
passages.text: Plus tibi quam Iuno, nocuit Venus: illa premendo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.12
passages.text: Sustulit, haec humili sub pede colla tenet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.13
passages.text: Respice vindicibus pacatum viribus orbem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.14
passages.text: Qua latam Nereus caerulus ambit humum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.15
passages.text: Se tibi pax terrae, tibi se tuta aequora debent;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.16
passages.text: Inplesti meritis solis utramque domum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.17
passages.text: Quod te laturum est, caelum prius ipse tulisti;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.18
passages.text: Hercule supposito sidera fulsit Atlans.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.19
passages.text: Quid nisi notitia est misero quaesita pudori,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.20
passages.text: Si cumulas turpi facta priora nota?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.21
passages.text: Tene ferunt geminos pressisse tenaciter angues,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.22
passages.text: Cum tener in cunis iam Iove dignus eras?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.23
passages.text: Coepisti melius quam desinis; ultima primis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.24
passages.text: Cedunt; dissimiles hic vir et ille puer.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.25
passages.text: Quem non mille ferae, quem non Stheneleius hostis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.26
passages.text: Non potuit Iuno vincere, vincit amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.27
passages.text: At bene nupta feror, quia nominer Herculis uxor,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.28
passages.text: Sitque socer, rapidis qui tonat altus equis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.29
passages.text: Quam male inaequales veniunt ad aratra iuvenci,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.30
passages.text: Tam premitur magno coniuge nupta minor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.31
passages.text: Non honor est sed onus species laesura ferentis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.32
passages.text: Siqua voles apte nubere, nube pari.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.33
passages.text: Vir mihi semper abest, et coniuge notior hospes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.34
passages.text: Monstraque terribiles persequiturque feras.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.35
passages.text: Ipsa domo vidua votis operata pudicis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.36
passages.text: Torqueor, infesto ne vir ab hoste cadat;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.37
passages.text: Inter serpentes aprosque avidosque leones

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.38
passages.text: Iactor et haesuros terna per ora canes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.39
passages.text: Me pecudum fibrae simulacraque inania somni

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.40
passages.text: Ominaque arcana nocte petita movent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.41
passages.text: Aucupor infelix incertae murmura famae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.42
passages.text: Speque timor dubia spesque timore cadit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.43
passages.text: Mater abest queriturque deo placuisse potenti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.44
passages.text: Nec pater Amphitryon nec puer Hyllus adest;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.45
passages.text: Arbiter Eurystheus astu Iunonis iniquae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.46
passages.text: Sentitur nobis iraque longa deae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.47
passages.text: Haec mihi ferre parum? peregrinos addis amores,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.48
passages.text: Et mater de te quaelibet esse potest.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.49
passages.text: Non ego Partheniis temeratam vallibus Augen,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.50
passages.text: Nec referam partus, Ormeni nympha, tuos;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.51
passages.text: Non tibi crimen erunt, Teuthrantia turba, sorores,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.52
passages.text: Quarum de populo nulla relicta tibi est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.53
passages.text: Una, recens crimen, referetur adultera nobis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.54
passages.text: Unde ego sum Lydo facta noverca Lamo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.55
passages.text: Maeandros, terris totiens errator in isdem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.56
passages.text: Qui lassas in se saepe retorquet aquas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.57
passages.text: Vidit in Herculeo suspensa monilia collo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.58
passages.text: Illo, cui caelum sarcina parva fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.59
passages.text: Non puduit fortis auro cohibere lacertos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.60
passages.text: Et solidis gemmas opposuisse toris?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.61
passages.text: Nempe sub his animam pestis Nemeaea lacertis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.62
passages.text: Edidit, unde umerus tegmina laevus habet!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.63
passages.text: Ausus es hirsutos mitra redimire capillos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.64
passages.text: Aptior Herculeae populus alba comae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.65
passages.text: Nec te Maeonia lascivae more puellae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.66
passages.text: Incingi zona dedecuisse putas?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.67
passages.text: Non tibi succurrit crudi Diomedis imago,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.68
passages.text: Efferus humana qui dape pavit equas?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.69
passages.text: Si te vidisset cultu Busiris in isto,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.70
passages.text: Huic victor victo nempe pudendus eras.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.71
passages.text: Detrahat Antaeus duro redimicula collo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.72
passages.text: Ne pigeat molli succubuisse viro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.73
passages.text: Inter Ioniacas calathum tenuisse puellas

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.74
passages.text: Diceris et dominae pertimuisse minas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.75
passages.text: Non fugis, Alcide, victricem mille laborum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.76
passages.text: Rasilibus calathis inposuisse manum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.77
passages.text: Crassaque robusto deducis pollice fila,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.78
passages.text: Aequaque famosae pensa rependis erae?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.79
passages.text: A, quotiens digitis dum torques stamina duris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.80
passages.text: Praevalidae fusos conminuere manus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.81
passages.text: Ante pedes dominae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.82
passages.text: Factaque narrabas dissimulanda tibi —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.85
passages.text: Scilicet inmanes elisis faucibus hydros

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.86
passages.text: Infantem caudis involuisse manum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.87
passages.text: Ut Tegeaeus aper cupressifero Erymantho

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.88
passages.text: Incubet et vasto pondere laedat humum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.89
passages.text: Non tibi Threiciis adfixa penatibus ora,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.90
passages.text: Non hominum pingues caede tacentur equae;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.91
passages.text: Prodigiumque triplex, armenti dives Hiberi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.92
passages.text: Geryones, quamvis in tribus unus erat;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.93
passages.text: Inque canes totidem trunco digestus ab uno

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.94
passages.text: Cerberos inplicitis angue minante comis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.95
passages.text: Quaeque redundabat fecundo vulnere serpens

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.96
passages.text: Fertilis et damnis dives ab ipsa suis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.97
passages.text: Quique inter laevumque latus laevumque lacertum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.98
passages.text: Praegrave conpressa fauce pependit onus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.99
passages.text: Et male confisum pedibus formaque bimembri

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.100
passages.text: Pulsum Thessalicis agmen equestre iugis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.101
passages.text: Haec tu Sidonio potes insignitus amictu

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.102
passages.text: Dicere? non cultu lingua retenta silet?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.103
passages.text: Se quoque nympha tuis ornavit Iardanis armis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.104
passages.text: Et tulit a capto nota tropaea viro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.105
passages.text: I nunc, tolle animos et fortia gesta recense;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.106
passages.text: Quo tu non esses, iure vir illa fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.107
passages.text: Qua tanto minor es, quanto te, maxime rerum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.108
passages.text: Quam quos vicisti, vincere maius erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.109
passages.text: Illi procedit rerum mensura tuarum —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.110
passages.text: Cede bonis; heres laudis amica tuae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.111
passages.text: O pudor! hirsuti costis exuta leonis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.112
passages.text: Aspera texerunt vellera molle latus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.113
passages.text: Falleris et nescis — non sunt spolia illa leonis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.114
passages.text: Sed tua, tuque feri victor es, illa tui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.115
passages.text: Femina tela tulit Lernaeis atra venenis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.116
passages.text: Ferre gravem lana vix satis apta colum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.117
passages.text: Instruxitque manum clava domitrice ferarum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.118
passages.text: Vidit et in speculo coniugis arma mei!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.119
passages.text: Haec tamen audieram; licuit non credere famae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.120
passages.text: Et venit ad sensus mollis ab aure dolor —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.121
passages.text: Ante meos oculos adducitur advena paelex,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.122
passages.text: Nec mihi, quae patior, dissimulare licet!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.123
passages.text: Non sinis averti; mediam captiva per urbem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.124
passages.text: Invitis oculis adspicienda venit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.125
passages.text: Nec venit incultis captarum more capillis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.126
passages.text: Fortunam vultu fassa decente suam;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.127
passages.text: Ingreditur late lato spectabilis auro,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.128
passages.text: Qualiter in Phrygia tu quoque cultus eras.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.129
passages.text: Dat vultum populo sublimis ut Hercule victo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.130
passages.text: Oechaliam vivo stare parente putes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.131
passages.text: Forsitan et pulsa Aetolide Deianira

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.132
passages.text: Nomine deposito paelicis uxor erit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.133
passages.text: Eurytidosque Ioles atque Aonii Alcidae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.134
passages.text: Turpia famosus corpora iunget Hymen.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.135
passages.text: Mens fugit admonitu, frigusque perambulat artus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.136
passages.text: Et iacet in gremio languida facta manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.137
passages.text: Me quoque cum multis, sed me sine crimine amasti.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.138
passages.text: Ne pigeat, pugnae bis tibi causa fui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.139
passages.text: Cornua flens legit ripis Achelous in udis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.140
passages.text: Truncaque limosa tempora mersit aqua;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.141
passages.text: Semivir occubuit in lotifero Eueno

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.142
passages.text: Nessus, et infecit sanguis equinus aquas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.143
passages.text: Sed quid ego haec refero? scribenti nuntia venit

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.144
passages.text: Fama, virum tunicae tabe perire meae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.145
passages.text: Ei mihi! quid feci? quo me furor egit amantem?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.146
passages.text: Inpia quid dubitas Deianira mori?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.147
passages.text: An tuus in media coniunx lacerabitur Oeta,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.148
passages.text: Tu sceleris tanti causa superstes eris?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.149
passages.text: Siquid adhuc habeo facti, cur Herculis uxor

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.150
passages.text: Credar, coniugii mors mea pignus erit!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.151
passages.text: Tu quoque cognosces in me, Meleagre, sororem!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.152
passages.text: Inpia quid dubitas Deianira mori?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.153
passages.text: Heu devota domus! solio sedet Agrios alto;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.154
passages.text: Oenea desertum nuda senecta premit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.155
passages.text: Exulat ignotis Tydeus germanus in oris;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.156
passages.text: Alter fatali vivus in igne situs;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.157
passages.text: Exegit ferrum sua per praecordia mater.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.158
passages.text: Inpia quid dubitas Deianira mori?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.159
passages.text: Deprecor hoc unum per iura sacerrima lecti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.160
passages.text: Ne videar fatis insidiata tuis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.161
passages.text: Nessus, ut est avidum percussus harundine pectus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.162
passages.text: 'Hic,' dixit, 'vires sanguis amoris habet.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.163
passages.text: Inlita Nesseo misi tibi texta veneno.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.164
passages.text: Inpia quid dubitas Deianira mori?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.165
passages.text: Iamque vale, seniorque pater germanaque Gorge,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.166
passages.text: Et patria et patriae frater adempte tuae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.167
passages.text: Et tu lux oculis hodierna novissima nostris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 9.168
passages.text: Virque — sed o possis! — et puer Hylle, vale!
